title: Video by earn.edits
description:
🐺 The movie about dirty money... was funded by dirty money 💸

🎬 This retro-style motion piece digs into the bizarre story behind The Wolf of Wall Street. Jonah Hill reportedly spent months on scenes with fake cocaine made from crushed Vitamin B tablets, and it contributed to bronchitis that required hospitalization 🏥

💰 Then the story gets stranger. The production was partly financed through money linked to 1MDB, Malaysia’s state investment fund. The U.S. Department of Justice later pursued assets allegedly bought with misappropriated funds, including interests connected to the film 🕵️

📼 Built with that vintage throwback look: cinematic movie imagery, financial documents, FBI investigation graphics, bold retro type, and dramatic transitions connecting the fiction to the real events

⚡ Coincidence... or the ultimate crime? 👀
